candidatos.por_que: Penta por los cinco tipos de colágeno (I, II, III, V y X) y -essa de condesa: realeza en cápsula.
Tres frentes (piel, cabello y uñas) con terminación francesa chic.
candidatos.eslogan: Piel, pelo y uñas en una.

candidatos.por_que: La actitud de quien parece no hacerse nada: el secreto va por dentro.
Del japonés kirei, que significa hermosa y limpia, latinizado con una a final.
candidatos.eslogan: Belleza que se toma en serio.

candidatos.por_que: Fusión de colágeno y vie (vida en francés): colágeno con vida propia.

verificacion: Búsqueda 'Pentessa collagen supplement brand': sin marcas de suplementos ni belleza con ese nombre. Libre.
publico: Mujeres de 25 a 40 años en Bogotá, Medellín y Cali, profesionales que invierten en skincare y quieren un solo suplemento serio para piel, cabello y uñas; siguen a dermatólogas en TikTok.
inspiracion: Ritual (transparencia de fórmula) con la estética de lujo silencioso de La Mer y Augustinus Bader.
logo_en: Wordmark 'PENTESSA' set in Cormorant Garamond SemiBold, all caps, generous 180 letter-spacing, color #2E2A29. Above the double S sits a small monogram: a perfect pentagon drawn with five thin hairline arcs that do not touch, each arc representing one collagen type, rendered in champagne gold #C9A96E. The two S letters have slightly elongated, calligraphic terminals. Below the wordmark, a tiny tagline 'MULTI-COLLAGEN I · II · III · V · X' in spaced small caps.
envase_en: Wide-mouth round supplement bottle, 250 ml, in matte soft-touch blush porcelain PET #F3E6DD with a heavy brushed champagne-gold aluminum screw cap #C9A96E, 60 capsules inside; the bottle has a subtle rounded shoulder and a thin debossed gold ring at the neck.
etiqueta_en: Full wraparound soft-touch label. Top center: pentagon monogram in hot gold foil. Center: PENTESSA wordmark large in #2E2A29. Beneath it, a horizontal row of five Roman numerals I II III V X in gold foil, each inside a tiny circle, connected by a hairline. Secondary line 'Colágeno multi-tipo + biotina + ácido hialurónico' in small serif italic, #B9857A. Bottom band: '60 cápsulas · piel · cabello · uñas'. Blind emboss of the pentagon pattern repeated faintly on the back panel; matte varnish base with spot gloss on the wordmark.
escena_en: Luxury campaign still life: the bottle standing on a stepped travertine pedestal, a draped ivory silk fabric behind, a few capsules and a single freshwater pearl scattered on the stone, a small sprig of dried pampas grass. Soft directional morning window light from the left with long gentle shadows, warm blush and cream tones, shallow depth of field, editorial beauty photography.
lifestyle_en: TikTok-style vertical shot in a bright Bogotá apartment bathroom with white subway tiles and a eucalyptus sprig in a vase: a woman's hand with a nude almond manicure and a thin gold ring holds one capsule above the open Pentessa bottle on the vanity, next to a small cup of tinto coffee and a jade face roller; overcast Andean morning light from a window, face not shown, natural iPhone look.

candidatos.por_que: Del ópalo, la piedra que brilla con luz propia desde adentro, como una piel luminosa.
De vidrio con terminación francesa: la piel de vidrio de la tendencia glass skin.
El look de cara lavada que se ve perfecta sin maquillaje.
candidatos.eslogan: Lo mejor de ti, sin base.

candidatos.por_que: Fusión de clara y vie (vida): una piel más clara y viva.
candidatos.eslogan: Claridad que se toma a sorbos.

candidatos.por_que: Del marfil (ivory), tono pulido y uniforme con terminación francesa.

verificacion: Búsqueda 'Opalé glutathione skin brand': solo aparecen marcas con 'Opal' (Opal Beauty en Pakistán, Opalore, Opal Gene), ninguna llamada Opalé ni de suplementos. Libre con tilde y grafía propia.
publico: Mujeres de 20 a 35 años fans del skincare coreano y del glow, que buscan piel luminosa y tono uniforme; compran por TikTok Shop e Instagram.
inspiracion: Tatcha y Glossier en sensibilidad de producto, con la iridiscencia de Fenty Beauty Gloss Bomb.
logo_en: Wordmark 'Opalé' in DM Serif Display, title case, tight kerning, color #3B3946; the accent over the e is replaced by a small faceted opal cabochon shape filled with an iridescent gradient from lilac #D9D2E9 to aqua #A8D8D0. A thin oval halo line surrounds the cabochon like a glint of light.
envase_en: 250 ml round liquid supplement bottle in frosted glass-look PET with an opalescent pearl coating #F7F4F2 that shifts lilac and aqua in light, a glossy pearl-white screw cap with a clear 15 ml dosing cup on top; liquid liposomal formula visible as a milky tone through the frosting.
etiqueta_en: Direct screen-printed label, no paper. Front: Opalé wordmark centered in graphite #3B3946, below it 'Glutatión liposomal 450 mg + vitamina C' in small serif. A vertical holographic foil strip runs down the left edge with a soft lilac-aqua rainbow effect. Back: clean ingredient panel in graphite, with a tiny opal cabochon icon. Matte frosted base with a high-gloss wordmark.
escena_en: Dreamy beauty campaign shot: the bottle on a mirrored acrylic plinth over a pale lilac backdrop, raw opal stones and translucent glass spheres around it, a splash of milky liquid frozen mid-air, prismatic rainbow light refractions from a crystal casting across the scene, soft diffused top light, iridescent highlights.
lifestyle_en: Instagram vertical shot in a sunny Cartagena colonial apartment with white walls and a bougainvillea outside the window: a woman's hand with a glossy lilac chrome manicure pours the liquid from the dosing cup into a small glass with ice and lime on a marble countertop, Opalé bottle next to it, golden Caribbean afternoon light, face not shown.

candidatos.por_que: Fusión de clara y bellezza (italiano): belleza que se aclara.
Égale es igual en francés: un tono parejo de frente a mentón.
candidatos.eslogan: Un solo tono, todo el día.

candidatos.por_que: Ni rastro de manchas: lo que se va no deja huella.
candidatos.eslogan: Lo que se va, no vuelve.

candidatos.por_que: Viene de iluminé, sin la i: la piel que se ilumina sola.
De unità, unidad en italiano: una piel de un solo tono.
candidatos.eslogan: Un tono, una piel, una tú.

verificacion: Se descartó Clarezza porque existe Clareza Cosmetics (marca de cuidado de piel muy parecida). Búsqueda 'Sin Rastro glutatión marca': no hay marca de suplementos ni belleza con ese nombre. Libre.
publico: Mujeres de 25 a 45 años con manchas por sol, embarazo o acné, cansadas de taparlas con corrector; compran con prueba social de antes y después en TikTok.
inspiracion: La actitud gráfica de Liquid Death con la sobriedad clínica de The Ordinary.
logo_en: Wordmark 'SIN RASTRO' in Archivo Black, all caps, stacked on two lines, jet black #111111. The word RASTRO looks partially erased: its last three letters fade out in a horizontal eraser stroke texture, leaving a clean smooth gap. A small circle with a diagonal line (a 'no' mark) sits as a tiny symbol after the wordmark.
envase_en: Round 150 ml supplement bottle in matte bone-white PET #F2EEE8 with a ribbed jet-black child-resistant screw cap #111111, 60 capsules, induction seal with a black tab; minimal pharmaceutical silhouette with a slightly squared shoulder.
etiqueta_en: Matte bone-white wraparound label. Huge black stacked SIN RASTRO wordmark occupying the top two thirds with the erased-letter effect. Below, a thin silver foil rule #BFC3C7 and the line 'Glutatión liposomal + vitamina C + selenio + resveratrol' in small caps. A small sand-colored #E8D5B5 dot grid that progressively disappears from left to right, visualizing spots fading. Back panel in black with white text. Uncoated tactile paper with silver foil details.
escena_en: Bold studio still life: the bottle centered on a seamless bone-colored backdrop, a white eraser and fine eraser crumbs on the surface, a sheet of tracing paper with a dark ink spot half erased beside it, hard crisp side light from the right casting a single sharp graphic shadow, high-contrast editorial look.
lifestyle_en: TikTok vertical shot in a modern Medellín apartment in El Poblado with plants and a balcony view of the mountains: a woman's hand with short bare natural nails sets the Sin Rastro bottle next to a bathroom mirror where a closed concealer and a makeup sponge lie unused, a glass of water, bright natural daylight, face not shown.

candidatos.por_que: Por la tendencia mochi skin: piel suave y elástica como el pastelito japonés.
Doble sentido colombiano: no me arrugo ante nada y mi piel tampoco.
candidatos.eslogan: Ni ante la vida ni el espejo.

candidatos.por_que: Fusión de colágeno y shot: un trago diario de 5.000 mg.
candidatos.eslogan: Un shot y a lo tuyo.

candidatos.por_que: Del inglés bounce españolizado: piel que rebota cuando la tocas.
candidatos.eslogan: Firmeza que se siente al tacto.

candidatos.por_que: Inventado de elástica con terminación francesa: piel que vuelve a su lugar.
candidatos.eslogan: La piel que vuelve a su lugar.

verificacion: Búsqueda 'Ni Me Arrugo colágeno marca': no existe marca de colágeno, suplementos ni belleza con ese nombre. Libre.
publico: Mujeres de 28 a 50 años, echadas pa'lante, con humor, que trabajan y no se dejan; quieren piel firme y rodillas sin dolor y les gusta reírse de la edad.
inspiracion: La irreverencia de Liquid Death y Toty de Sofía Vergara, con el color y la alegría de Poppi.
logo_en: Wordmark 'NI ME ARRUGO' in Anton, all caps, condensed and tall, set on two lines (NI ME / ARRUGO) in near-black #1D1D1B. The letters of ARRUGO are perfectly smooth and stretched tight, while a tiny crumpled-paper icon next to it is crossed out. A small coral #FF6F61 sticker-style circle reads '5.000 mg' at a tilted angle like a badge.
envase_en: Box of 15 single-serve liquid collagen shot vials, 25 ml each, in clear glass-look PET with a flat coral aluminum peel-off cap #FF6F61; the liquid inside is a pale peach tone. The outer carton is a tall rectangular box in cream #FFE8D6 with a front die-cut window showing the vials lined up.
etiqueta_en: Each vial carries a slim cream shrink sleeve with NI ME ARRUGO in black Anton running vertically, a sunshine yellow #FFC857 band at the bottom with '5.000 mg colágeno hidrolizado'. The carton has a matte cream base, glossy black wordmark, coral foil 5.000 mg badge and a tongue-in-cheek line on the side 'Prohibido arrugarse'. Smooth embossed lines radiate from the wordmark like stretched fabric.
escena_en: Playful pop campaign photo: vials standing on a cream acrylic block against a coral backdrop, a perfectly ironed silk ribbon and an old-fashioned clothes iron as props, one vial uncapped with a droplet on the lip, bright high-key studio light with hard colorful shadows, saturated and joyful.
lifestyle_en: TikTok vertical shot in a Barranquilla kitchen with colorful tiles and a ceiling fan: a woman's hand with bright coral nails and gold bangles cracks open a vial and lifts it like a toast, the carton beside a plate of mango and a glass of ice water, warm Caribbean morning light, face not shown, candid fun energy.

candidatos.por_que: Viene de astaxantina y se pronuncia como santé, salud en francés.
Fusión de alga y aré: la microalga roja que se vuelve tu escudo.
La microalga produce una tinta roja intensa que tiñe al flamenco: esa es la fórmula.
Roja en italiano: el color de la astaxantina con sonido latino.
Estrella en latín, por la astaxantina y su brillo antioxidante.

verificacion: Búsqueda 'Xanthé astaxanthin supplement brand': no hay marca con ese nombre (aparecen BioAstin, NOW Zanthin, Sports Research). Libre.
publico: Mujeres y hombres de 30 a 50 años, deportistas y amantes del sol (ciclistas, runners, playeros) que buscan piel joven y recuperación muscular.
inspiracion: Augustinus Bader en lujo científico con el tono editorial de Aesop.
logo_en: Wordmark 'XANTHÉ' in Playfair Display Bold, all caps, high-contrast serifs, deep garnet #8E1B2E. The X is slightly larger and its crossing point holds a tiny round ruby droplet that represents a single softgel. The acute accent over the E is drawn as a thin gold #C9A227 sliver like a sun ray.
envase_en: Opaque ivory #F6EFE6 glass jar, squat and wide, 120 ml, with a heavy polished gold metal screw lid #C9A227, holding 60 translucent ruby-red softgels; light-protective opaque body to guard the astaxanthin.
etiqueta_en: Wraparound uncoated ivory paper label. Center: XANTHÉ wordmark in garnet with a blind-embossed microalgae cell pattern (small concentric circles) around it. Below: 'Astaxantina natural 12 mg · Haematococcus pluvialis' in small caps. A single horizontal band of gradient from coral #E2574C to garnet #8E1B2E across the lower third. Gold foil on the accent and on a small seal reading 'from microalgae'. Matte finish with spot gloss on the ruby droplet.
escena_en: Editorial still life: the jar on a polished red travertine slab, ruby softgels spilling from a small gold dish, a petri dish with deep red microalgae liquid, a pink flamingo feather lying across the stone, warm golden-hour sunlight streaming low from the side through a window with palm shadows, rich red and gold tones.
lifestyle_en: Instagram vertical shot on a Santa Marta beach terrace at sunset: a tanned hand with a sports watch picks a ruby softgel from the open Xanthé jar resting on a wooden table next to a bicycle helmet and a coconut, sea and Sierra Nevada mountains softly blurred behind, warm orange light, face not shown.

candidatos.por_que: NAD+ en el corazón del nombre, y en árabe nadira significa rara y preciosa.
Cumples años, pero tus células soplan menos velas.
Eterna en francés, en femenino: juventud que no se va.
Fusión de resveratrol y nirvana: el estado de calma de una célula joven.
De uva, la fruta del resveratrol, con terminación ara que suena a nombre propio.
candidatos.eslogan: El secreto de la uva negra.

verificacion: Búsqueda 'Nadira NAD supplement or beauty brand': solo aparece una maquilladora personal (Nadira V Persaud), no una marca de suplementos ni de cosmética de producto. Libre en suplementos.
publico: Hombres y mujeres de 35 a 55 años, ejecutivos y emprendedores biohackers que siguen a Bryan Johnson y Huberman, buscan energía y longevidad.
inspiracion: Tru Niagen y Timeline (Mitopure) en ciencia, con la sobriedad de Hims y la exclusividad de un perfume nicho.
logo_en: Wordmark 'NADIRA' in Montserrat Light, all caps, very wide 300 letter-spacing, champagne #D8C3A5 on midnight navy. The letters N-A-D are in Montserrat SemiBold and the rest in Light, subtly highlighting NAD. Above the wordmark, a minimal symbol: a small plus sign enclosed in a perfect circle made of a thin orbit line, like a mitochondrion in orbit.
envase_en: Cylindrical 150 ml bottle in deep midnight navy #0E1A2B violet-tinted glass-look PET with a matte black screw cap with a thin champagne metallic ring, holding 60 dark plum softgels; heavy, minimal, pharmaceutical-luxury silhouette.
etiqueta_en: Soft-touch midnight navy label with the NADIRA wordmark and orbit symbol in champagne hot foil. A thin vertical gradient line from plum #6B2D5C to champagne runs down the center like a timeline. Small caps 'NAD+ liposomal · trans-resveratrol 1.200 mg'. Back panel with a precise scientific data grid in off-white #F4F1EC. Blind-embossed fine dot pattern across the label like a cell matrix.
escena_en: Dark luxury still life: the bottle on a black obsidian slab, a cluster of deep purple grapes and a single cut grape revealing its interior, a glass laboratory beaker with plum liquid, low-key lighting with a single champagne-toned rim light and a soft spotlight from above, deep navy background with subtle haze.
lifestyle_en: Instagram vertical shot in a modern home office in Bogotá's Chicó neighborhood at dawn: a man's hand with a minimalist steel watch takes a softgel next to a laptop showing a sleep and HRV chart, a black coffee and the Nadira bottle on a walnut desk, city skyline and Monserrate mountain in soft fog behind the window, cool blue morning light, face not shown.

candidatos.por_que: Del griego kolla, pegamento, la raíz de la palabra colágeno.
Escaleras, montañas y la vida: subes y bajas sin que nada te duela.
Fusión de latte y colágeno: se disuelve en tu café de todos los días.
Colágeno para mí: un ritual propio, sin compartir.
Del vaivén: el movimiento libre de articulaciones sanas y una piel que se mueve contigo.

verificacion: Se descartó Kolla porque ya existen Kolla Code Collagen y Kollo Health (colágeno). Búsqueda 'Vaivé colágeno marca': no aparece ninguna marca con ese nombre. Libre.
publico: Mujeres y hombres de 30 a 55 años, activos (yoga, caminata, pádel) que toman café a diario y quieren articulaciones flexibles y piel firme sin pastillas.
inspiracion: Vital Proteins de Jennifer Aniston en ritual diario, con la estética cálida y artesanal de Aesop y Arrae.
logo_en: Lowercase wordmark 'vaivé' in Quicksand Medium, rounded and soft, espresso #2F2B26. The accent over the final e is drawn as a small double wave (two connected curves) in terracotta #D4886A, suggesting rhythmic motion. The two v letters have slightly rounded points, forming a subtle visual rhythm v-v.
envase_en: Matte oat-colored #E9DCC9 cylindrical paper-and-tin canister, 300 g, with a natural bamboo screw lid and a bamboo measuring scoop inside; inner foil seal. Sage green #7A8B6F band at the base.
etiqueta_en: Printed directly on the canister in a soft uncoated texture. The vaivé wordmark sits in the upper center; below it a line illustration of a single continuous wave that loops around the can like a ribbon, in terracotta. Text in small caps: 'Colágeno hidrolizado tipo I y III · 10 g por porción · sin sabor'. Sage band at the bottom with '300 g · 30 porciones'. Blind emboss on the wave line and a tiny copper foil dot on the accent.
escena_en: Warm wellness still life: the canister on a raw linen cloth over a light oak table, the bamboo scoop holding a mound of fine white powder, a ceramic mug of café con leche with a swirl, a yoga strap coiled beside, dried eucalyptus, soft side light from a large window with gentle morning warmth, earthy oat and terracotta tones.
lifestyle_en: TikTok vertical shot in a Medellín kitchen with clay tiles and plants: a hand with a woven bracelet stirs a scoop of powder into a mug of Colombian tinto with a small wooden spoon, the vaivé canister open beside a rolled yoga mat leaning on the counter, green mountains visible through the window, soft morning light, face not shown.

candidatos.por_que: Kami significa cabello en japonés: el ritual de las melenas largas de Oriente.
candidatos.eslogan: El secreto japonés del cabello largo.

candidatos.por_que: Soltarse el pelo es soltarse uno: libertad y melena larga.
Fusión de biotina y larga: el pelo que siempre quisiste.
De crin, la melena larga y brillante, con doble n que suena exclusiva.
De onda: el movimiento del pelo largo al viento.
candidatos.eslogan: Ondas que no paran de crecer.

verificacion: Búsqueda 'Kamí biotin hair supplement brand': no hay marca de biotina con ese nombre; solo aparece Kaminomoto (tónico japonés, nombre distinto). Libre.
publico: Mujeres de 18 a 35 años que quieren el pelo largo y abundante, fans de rutinas de cabello asiáticas y del hair oiling en TikTok.
inspiracion: Shiseido y Tatcha en ritual japonés, con la minimalidad gráfica de Muji y Ouai.
logo_en: Wordmark 'KAMÍ' in Syne Bold, all caps, wide and geometric, lacquer black #111111. To the right, a small square vermilion #C8102E hanko seal stamp containing the Japanese kanji for hair (髪) in white, with a slightly irregular hand-stamped edge. The accent on the I is a single fine brushstroke flowing down like a strand of hair.
envase_en: 60 ml square-shouldered glossy black glass dropper bottle #111111 with a bronze-finish metal collar #B08D57, black rubber bulb and a calibrated glass pipette; liquid biotin formula, amber-gold liquid visible in the pipette.
etiqueta_en: Rice-paper-textured off-white #F3EDE2 label wrapped around the black bottle like a vertical obi band. KAMÍ wordmark vertically aligned in black, vermilion hanko seal in red foil, a single long black brush-stroke line descending the label like a hair strand. Small text 'Biotina líquida 10.000 µg + vitamina E + selenio'. Deckled paper edge, blind emboss on the seal, matte finish.
escena_en: Japanese minimalist still life: the bottle on a black lacquer tray over smooth river stones, a wooden comb and a sprig of cherry blossom, a single drop falling from the pipette, a rice paper shoji screen backdrop with soft diffused side light and gentle shadows, calm muted palette with red accents.
lifestyle_en: Instagram vertical shot in a Bogotá apartment bedroom with linen sheets and a window to the rainy city: a woman's hand with long dark hair falling over her shoulder squeezes the dropper into a glass of water on a wooden nightstand, the Kamí bottle and a wooden comb beside it, soft grey morning light, face not shown, only the long glossy hair visible from behind.

candidatos.por_que: Fusión de yum y belle: lo rico que te pone bella.
El único vicio que te deja más linda: no te vas a querer comer solo una.
candidatos.eslogan: El único vicio que te embellece.

candidatos.por_que: Caramelo en italiano: un dulce con alma de belleza europea.
Inventado de bella y biotina, corto y sonoro como un apodo.
Fusión de goma y manía: la gomita que se vuelve obsesión.

verificacion: Búsqueda 'Vicio Lindo marca gomitas': no aparece ninguna marca de gomitas, suplementos ni belleza con ese nombre. Libre.
publico: Mujeres de 16 a 30 años, universitarias y creadoras de contenido, que aman lo estético, compran por impulso en TikTok Shop y prefieren gomitas a pastillas.
inspiracion: SugarBearHair y Toty de Sofía Vergara, con el color descarado de Poppi.
logo_en: Script wordmark 'Vicio Lindo' in Pacifico, hot pink #FF4F8B, flowing as one continuous handwritten line with a playful swash under 'Lindo'. The dot of the first i is replaced by a tiny glossy lip-shaped gummy, and a small sparkle star sits at the end of the swash.
envase_en: Wide round 300 ml translucent pink PET jar #FFD3E2 with a glossy hot pink screw cap #FF4F8B, showing 60 lip-shaped pink gummies inside dusted with fine sugar; a shiny holographic shrink band seals the lid.
etiqueta_en: Glossy cream #FFF5E1 front label with rounded corners. Vicio Lindo script in hot pink with a thin grape-purple #7B2D8E outline shadow. Below, a bubble-shaped badge 'Biotina 5.000 µg + vitamina C + E + zinc'. Scattered tiny lip and heart icons in holographic foil. A cheeky small line on the side: 'Advertencia: crea hábito bonito'. Puffy raised UV varnish on the logo.
escena_en: Candy pop campaign shot: the jar on a glossy pink acrylic pedestal against a cotton-candy pink backdrop, lip-shaped gummies scattered and some stacked, a vintage heart-shaped candy dish, pink satin ribbon, a few pearls, bright high-key soft-box light with a glossy sheen, saturated pinks and purples.
lifestyle_en: TikTok vertical shot in a Cali bedroom with fairy lights and a ring light off to the side: a hand with long pink almond nails and charm rings pinches a lip-shaped gummy out of the open jar resting on a vanity full of lip glosses and a mirror with photos, warm golden evening light, face not shown, playful selfie-style angle.

candidatos.por_que: Mallia significa cabello en griego, y suena a nombre de mujer.
Es lo que te dice tu pelo cuando deja de caerse en la ducha: me quedo.
Inventado de tresses (mechones en francés e inglés): mechones fuertes y largos.
Fusión de zinc y cabello: los minerales que sostienen tu melena.
Ni un pelo menos en el cepillo, como dice el dicho colombiano.

verificacion: Se descartó Mallia porque ya existe Mallia Aesthetics/Therapeutics (Alemania), con productos contra la caída del cabello. Búsqueda 'Me Quedo biotina cabello marca': no hay marca con ese nombre. Libre.
publico: Mujeres de 22 a 45 años con caída por estrés, postparto o tintes, que hoy compran Vitybell o biotina genérica en droguería y quieren algo que se vea más bonito y confiable.
inspiracion: Nutrafol en confianza, con la cercanía de Vitybell y la limpieza visual de Hims.
logo_en: Lowercase wordmark 'me quedo.' in Abril Fatface, deep aubergine #2B2140, with a decisive final period in copper #B87333. The descender of the q extends downward into a slender line ending in a small rounded bulb, like a hair strand anchored firmly by its root. Clean, confident, high-contrast.
envase_en: Round 200 ml supplement bottle in matte deep aubergine PET #2B2140 with a brushed copper-tone screw cap #B87333, containing 60 amber softgels; induction seal and a slight satin sheen on the shoulder.
etiqueta_en: Soft-touch aubergine wraparound label. me quedo. wordmark centered in nude #E7B7A3 with the copper foil period. Below it, a row of ingredient pills in outlined capsules: 'Biotina 5.000 mcg · Zinc · Selenio · Cobre · B3 · B5'. A fine-line illustration of a single hair strand with its root, in copper foil, running vertically on the side. Back panel in off-white #F5EFE8. Embossed root line and matte-gloss contrast on the logo.
escena_en: Elegant still life: the bottle on a warm nude stone plinth, a few amber softgels and a wooden wide-tooth comb with zero hairs in it, a copper bowl, a long silky lock of dark hair arranged in an S-curve on the surface, soft golden side light with a gentle gradient backdrop from nude to aubergine.
lifestyle_en: TikTok vertical shot in a Bogotá bathroom with a glass shower: a woman's hand holds up a hairbrush with no hair in it toward the camera, the me quedo. bottle on the sink next to a towel and a toothbrush cup, steam on the mirror, soft morning light, face not shown, only long wet hair over the shoulder visible.

candidatos.por_que: Lleva el DIM, su activo estrella, dentro de un nombre que suena a mujer segura.
Del griego hormé, el impulso que le dio nombre a las hormonas.
candidatos.eslogan: Equilibrio que se ve en la piel.

candidatos.por_que: Porque ya no tienes nada que tapar con corrector.
De nueva: piel nueva cada ciclo, con terminación francesa.
Fusión de cutis y la e francesa: el cutis que siempre quisiste.

verificacion: Búsqueda 'Dimara skin acne supplement brand': no existe marca con ese nombre (solo aparecen MDacne, Dermala, Porelesque). Libre.
publico: Mujeres de 16 a 32 años con acné hormonal en mandíbula y mentón, cansadas de cremas que no funcionan; siguen a dermatólogas en TikTok y hablan de ciclo menstrual sin tabú.
inspiracion: Dermala y Starface en cercanía gen Z, con la limpieza científica de Ritual.
logo_en: Lowercase wordmark 'dimara' in Fredoka SemiBold, rounded and friendly, eucalyptus green #3E6B5A. The dot of the i is a small circle split in two halves, one peach #F2C6B4 and one mint, symbolizing hormonal balance; the a letters have perfectly round bowls echoing smooth skin.
envase_en: Round 150 ml supplement bottle in frosted translucent mint PET #E9F0EA with a matte eucalyptus green flip-top cap #3E6B5A, 60 capsules visible softly through the frosting; rounded friendly silhouette.
etiqueta_en: Clear transparent label so the frosted bottle shows through, printed in eucalyptus and peach. dimara wordmark big at center, under it a playful line 'acné hormonal' in a peach pill-shaped tag, and the ingredient line 'DIM + zinc + probióticos + niacinamida'. A thin circular cycle diagram (28 dots in a ring, with the four phases subtly marked) printed in white ink around the logo. Peach foil on the split dot, soft-touch matte finish.
escena_en: Fresh clinical-cute still life: the bottle on a mint ceramic tile surface with a glass of water with cucumber slices, a few capsules on a small round peach dish, a monthly paper calendar with a circled date, sprigs of broccoli sprouts (source of DIM) arranged artfully, bright diffused daylight with clean soft shadows.
lifestyle_en: TikTok vertical shot in a Bucaramanga student apartment with a mirror covered in small photos and a bright window: a hand with short natural nails and a hair claw clip on the counter takes a capsule from the open dimara bottle next to a phone showing a period tracker app and a pink pimple patch box set aside, warm daylight, face not shown.

candidatos.por_que: Inventado de tri y bella: tres bellezas (cabello, piel y uñas) en una perla.
Una perla que te cuida de pies a cabeza, toda tú.
candidatos.eslogan: De la raíz a la uña.

candidatos.por_que: Fusión de queratina y vie: la proteína del cabello con vida.
Omni (todo) más bé de belleza: el multivitamínico de la belleza completa.
Del ámbar, el color dorado de la cápsula blanda que brilla al sol.

verificacion: Tutta se descartó por ser casi igual a Tutti de otro grupo. Búsqueda 'Ámbara supplement beauty brand': no hay marca de suplementos con ese nombre (solo una crema 'Ambar Gold', nombre distinto). Libre.
publico: Mujeres de 25 a 45 años que quieren un solo multivitamínico de belleza que lo cubra todo, sensuales y seguras, que aman el dorado, la playa y el bronceado.
inspiracion: La calidez dorada de Sol de Janeiro y Fenty Skin con la simpleza de OLLY.
logo_en: Wordmark 'Ámbara' in Playfair Display Italic, title case, deep cognac brown #5A2E12. The accent over the Á is a small teardrop-shaped amber gem with a warm gradient from honey #E0A030 to caramel #C98B5B and a tiny white highlight, as if it were a softgel catching the sun. A thin golden oval frame surrounds the wordmark like the edge of a resin drop.
envase_en: Round 200 ml glossy translucent amber glass-look PET bottle tinted honey #E0A030 with a polished gold screw cap, holding 60 golden softgels visible through the warm amber body; rounded apothecary shoulders.
etiqueta_en: Cream #F8F1E4 front label with an arched top. Ámbara wordmark in cognac with the amber gem accent in gold foil. Below, a line of small icons for hair, skin and nails in fine gold line art, and the text 'Biotina + MSM + colágeno + complejo B + C + D3'. Radiating sunburst lines in blind emboss behind the logo, gold foil border, gloss varnish on the gem.
escena_en: Golden-hour campaign still life: the bottle on a raw honey-colored onyx slab with golden softgels scattered like drops of resin, a piece of natural amber with an inclusion, a honey dipper, a sheer gold silk fabric, warm low sun from the side creating glowing translucency through the bottle and long amber shadows.
lifestyle_en: Instagram vertical shot on a rooftop terrace in Santa Marta at sunset: a sun-kissed hand with a gold chain bracelet and a nude manicure holds a golden softgel up against the orange sky so it glows, the Ámbara bottle on a rattan side table next to a glass of iced water and sunglasses, warm golden light, face not shown.

candidatos.por_que: Chioma es melena larga y abundante en italiano poético.
La respuesta orgullosa a la pregunta que nadie quiere oír: ¿y el pelo? Hay pelo.
Fusión de biotina y palma, por el saw palmetto (palma enana).
Entre volumen y volar: pelo con cuerpo que se mueve.
De denso con terminación francesa: pelo tupido de verdad.

verificacion: Se descartó Chioma porque ya existen CHIOMA y Chioma Hair Care (crecimiento de cabello); Pa'Rato se cambió por chocar con otro grupo. Búsqueda 'Hay Pelo marca suplemento cabello biotina': no existe marca con ese nombre. Libre.
publico: Hombres y mujeres de 25 a 45 años con entradas o adelgazamiento del cabello, que quieren frenarlo con algo natural (saw palmetto) y hablan sin pena del tema.
inspiracion: Hims y Keeps en franqueza sobre la calvicie, con la actitud gráfica de Liquid Death y el orgullo local de Juan Valdez.
logo_en: Wordmark 'HAY PELO' in Bebas Neue, all caps, tall and condensed, stacked on two lines in palm green #0B3D2E. The counter of the letter O in PELO is filled with a small stylized fan-shaped saw palmetto leaf in straw gold #D9C27E, and three short vertical strokes rise from the top of the H like fresh hair growth. A thin rule underneath with tiny caps 'BIOTINA · SAW PALMETTO · QUERATINA'.
envase_en: Round 200 ml matte palm-green HDPE supplement bottle #0B3D2E with a ribbed matte black screw cap #1A1A1A, 60 capsules; robust, unisex, slightly taller apothecary proportions.
etiqueta_en: Off-white #F4EFE6 uncoated paper label with a large stacked HAY PELO wordmark in green, the palm leaf inside the O in straw-gold foil. A side badge reads 'Biotina 10.000 µg + saw palmetto + colágeno + queratina'. Thin vintage frame border like a Colombian rum or coffee label, with small palm leaf line illustrations in the corners. Letterpress-style deboss on the wordmark, gold foil accents.
escena_en: Rugged premium still life: the bottle on a dark weathered wood surface with fresh fan palm leaves behind casting dramatic shadows, a horn comb, a vintage barber brush and a few capsules, warm late-afternoon light filtering through the palm fronds, earthy green and gold tones with deep shadows.
lifestyle_en: Instagram vertical shot in a Cali home bathroom with green tiles and a round mirror: a man's hand with a leather bracelet runs fingers through thick dark hair at the back of the head while the other hand holds the Hay Pelo bottle, a towel over the shoulder and a wooden comb on the sink, warm tropical afternoon light, face not shown.
